steps.run: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Choose a model"]'); const search = [...(menu?.querySelectorAll('input') ?? [])].find(input => input.labels?.[0]?.textContent === 'Search models'); window.modelMenuOpeningBox = menu.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON(); return { menuOpens: menu?.checkVisibility() === true, modelSearchFocused: !!search && document.activeElement === search, standInModelChosen: menu?.querySelector('button[aria-current=true]')?.textContent.startsWith('Faux typing') === true, thinkingEffortShowsMedium: menu?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Thinking effort"]')?.getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === 'Medium' && menu.innerText.includes('Thinking effort\nMedium') }; })()

drag.on: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Thinking effort"]').nextElementSibling.getBoundingClientRect(); return [box.left + box.width / 2, box.top + box.height / 2]; })()

steps.run: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Choose a model"]'); const pill = [...document.querySelectorAll('main button[aria-expanded]')].find(button => button.textContent.includes('Faux typing')); const box = menu.getBoundingClientRect(); return { menuKeepsOpeningPosition: Math.abs(box.left - window.modelMenuOpeningBox.left) < 1 && Math.abs(box.top - window.modelMenuOpeningBox.top) < 1, effortChangesToHigh: menu?.querySelector('input[aria-label="Thinking effort"]')?.getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === 'High' && menu.innerText.includes('Thinking effort\nHigh'), messageBoxShowsHigh: pill?.innerText.includes('High') === true, menuStaysOpen: menu?.checkVisibility() === true && pill?.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' }; })()

({ searchFindsNothing: document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Choose a model"]')?.innerText.includes('No models match.') === true && !document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Choose a model"]').innerText.includes('Faux typing'), effortStaysInMenu: document.querySelector('[role=dialog][aria-label="Choose a model"] input[aria-label="Thinking effort"]')?.getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === 'High' })
